subject: CS360
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos covering all topics. For English, videos from textbook author Jim Kurose and other highly-regarded creators like Ben Eater were chosen for their authority and clarity. For Arabic, the channel 'Mustafa S. Aljumaily' provided excellent, highly-viewed content for four of the five topics, demonstrating its strength in academic networking concepts. Some topics had limited Arabic options, with several candidates failing gates for low views, irrelevant content (e.g., programming control flow), or incorrect language.
